text: Panel time, three voices tonight, and a question for each of you in turn. Let us start with the newest member of the team. Delighted to be here. The hardest part of multi-speaker audio for me is turn-taking, because the model must decide when one person has finished. 大家好，很高兴参加这个节目。我认为最困难的是多人同时说话的时候，模型需要分辨每一个人的声音。 And that is the three-voice problem in one clip: two accents of English and one full turn of Mandarin, with a real speaker rotation between every turn.
